items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1975-02-19
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] And also of Pete Fountain, Jack Delaney, George Gerard.

ctx.x: But I might mention that Johnny Wiggs was the teacher of Charlie DeVore.
And also of Pete Fountain, Jack Delaney, George Gerard.
But for me, Charlie DeVore is a particular interest because he plays in the Hall Brothers band in Mendota.
